summary: Market still digesting Nvidia's CEO exit: NVDA roughly -7 to -8% (~160) after bouncing off 148.80, S&P 500 about -0.4%, Nasdaq about -0.6%. Live quotes blocked, prices estimated. No change since the last update: no new news found and indexes holding the same range.
